newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan detains one Japanese fishing boat, 11 crew.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan detains one Japanese fishing boat, 11 crew.

text.p: Taiwan prosecutors and marine police on Thursday night detained a Japanese fishing vessel and charged 11 crew for penetrating the island's territorial waters, local newspapers reported on Friday.
Marine police led by prosecutors chased three Japanese fishing vessels offshore the southern county of Pingtung but two vessels escaped, local newspapers said.
Prosecutors detained the Japanese vessel and crew of nine Japanese and two Indonesians, the United Daily News said.
It was the first time Taiwan had detained a Japanese vessel since 1980, the newspaper said.
The China Times newspaper quoted the Japanese vessel's captain as saying he knew his vessel had penetrated Taiwan's territorial waters.
Prosecutors and marine police were not immediately available to comment.
